Container.Name: proxmox_manager
Container.Overview: Enterprise Proxmox VE Control Center & Management Dashboard with Wake-on-LAN and real-time telemetry.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Host web port mapped to container port 3000

Config.Name: DATABASE_URL
Config.Description: Base PostgreSQL connection URL pointing to the host PostgreSQL instance

Config.Name: PROJECT_DB_NAME
Config.Description: Project-specific database name auto-provisioned at boot

Config.Name: COOKIE_SECURE
Config.Description: Set to true if behind HTTPS reverse proxy, false for local HTTP

Config.Name: INIT_ADMIN_EMAIL
Config.Description: Initial administrator email auto-seeded into DB

Config.Name: STRICT_ENV_VALIDATION
Config.Description: Enforces strict fail-fast env validation at boot

Config.Name: PROXMOX_HOST
Config.Description: IP address or hostname of the Proxmox VE server

Config.Name: PROXMOX_NODE
Config.Description: Proxmox VE target cluster node name

Config.Name: PROXMOX_USER
Config.Description: Proxmox VE username or API Token ID (e.g., root@pam or user@pve!tokenid)

Config.Name: PROXMOX_PASSWORD
Config.Description: Proxmox VE password or API Token Secret

Config.Name: PROXMOX_SSL_INSECURE
Config.Description: Allow connection to self-signed TLS certificates on Proxmox

Config.Name: PROXMOX_MAC_ADDRESS
Config.Description: Hardware MAC address of the Proxmox motherboard network interface for Wake-on-LAN

Config.Name: PROXMOX_WOL_BROADCAST
Config.Description: Broadcast IP address for Wake-on-LAN Magic Packets
